answer: We map the trust topology via a spectral atlas, proving that boundary Fiedler values restrict EigenTrust diffusion from honest nodes to adversarial clusters. At the dawn of each epoch, this transition matrix isolates the ivory subgraphs of consensus validators. By coupling this spectral partition with zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions and severe slashing penalties on staking collateral, we prove that Sybil attacks yield negative expected utility, enforcing a robust Nash equilibrium.
